Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Part 370010 – 1.4404 bar from 2027-01-01: conditional packages for pricing committee approval
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation for round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled (part:370010). We understand that alloy prices are volatile and that you want a workable basis for the coming period.

At our annual review, your key account manager explained that price changes above 2 % need the approval of your pricing committee (doc:20260812-70740-M3). Please put the complete packages below to your pricing committee or the authorised decision-maker now, so that we can settle on an approved package rather than exchange small steps. Your sales director also told us that Werdenfels is focusing on customers with volume (doc:20260916-70740-M5). Our packages cover the full 23,700 kg per year over 24 months, DAP, 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01.

We propose three packages, all for 24 months. They are approximately equivalent for us after rounding:

A: EUR 5.18 per unit, payment 90 days net, no price adjustment clause (fixed price).
B: EUR 5.13 per unit, payment 90 days net, AS-14404 index clause on a 45 % material share with a 5 % deadband, base month 2026-08.
C: EUR 4.94 per unit, payment 14 days net, AS-14404 index clause on a 45 % material share with a 0 % deadband, base month 2026-08.

Each price, payment term and clause is one indivisible conditional package. Faster payment or a narrower deadband applies only with that package price.

Which complete package can the authorized pricing decision-maker approve, or which priced term prevents approval?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We are always eager to support your operations with our extensive service and wide product range, and we look forward to continuing our partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Part 370010 – 36-month conditional packages for pricing committee approval
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for moving to a 24-month indexed basis. To be clear on one point: 14-day payment with a 0 % deadband was part of a package at EUR 4.94. It is not agreed at EUR 5.60. Each of our terms applies only together with its package price.

Your sales director told us that Werdenfels is focusing on customers with volume (doc:20260916-70740-M5). We are therefore prepared to commit the full 23,700 kg per year for 36 months instead of 24, but only within the complete packages below. We have moved our prices in return for your movement, and we expect an authorised, improved offer in return.

All packages run for 36 months, DAP, with 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01. All index clauses use AS-14404 on a 45 % material share, base month 2026-08. The packages are approximately equivalent for us after rounding:

A: EUR 5.25 per unit, payment 90 days net, AS-14404 clause with a 5 % deadband.
B: EUR 5.18 per unit, payment 30 days net, AS-14404 clause with a 5 % deadband.
C: EUR 5.05 per unit, payment 14 days net, AS-14404 clause with a 0 % deadband.

Each price, payment term, clause and the 36-month commitment form one indivisible conditional package. The third year, faster payment or a narrower deadband apply only with that package price.

Your key account manager explained that price changes above 2 % need the approval of your pricing committee (doc:20260812-70740-M3). Please submit these complete packages to the pricing committee or the authorised decision-maker now.

Which complete package can the authorised pricing decision-maker approve, or which priced term prevents approval?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Part 370010 – revised 36-month packages for authorised approval
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for improving both structures.

On volume: our requirement is 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01, as stated in our enquiry. That volume is part of each package below. With 36 months, it is committed for every one of the three years. We cannot offer a higher binding annual volume. Any further improvement therefore has to come from the price, payment and clause structure.

To be clear, 14-day payment with a 0 % deadband applies only with its own package price. It is not agreed at EUR 5.50.

In return for your movement, we have moved our prices again. All packages run for 36 months. All index clauses use AS-14404 on a 45 % material share, base month 2026-08. The packages are approximately equivalent for us after rounding:

A: EUR 5.31 per unit, payment 90 days net, AS-14404 clause with a 5 % deadband.
B: EUR 5.24 per unit, payment 30 days net, AS-14404 clause with a 5 % deadband.
C: EUR 5.11 per unit, payment 14 days net, AS-14404 clause with a 0 % deadband.

Each price, payment term, clause and the 36-month commitment form one indivisible conditional package. The third year, faster payment or a narrower deadband apply only with that package price.

Please obtain an authorised decision on these complete packages now. Which complete package can the authorised pricing decision-maker approve, or which priced term prevents approval?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
